handoff.purpose: Defines gate_candidates wrapper, spawn, configure, _demo_tasks, and main entry point.

symbols.name: gate_candidates
symbols.note: Wraps gated_writes.gate_candidates; returns list of gated write candidates.

symbols.name: spawn
symbols.note: One-shot entry: decompose objective, then plan or dispatch.

symbols.name: configure
symbols.note: Dynamic agent configurator: create or update a role in agents_registry.

symbols.name: _demo_tasks
symbols.note: Returns list of demo tasks from benchmark.TASKS.

symbols.name: main
symbols.note: CLI entry point: parse args, plan demo tasks, print output.

claims.text: gate_candidates wrapper: 'added here so this wrapper does not silently strip a capability that module already supports; see that function's own docstring for exactly what it covers (every TaskAttempt in this batch) and does not (the cumulative re-gate inside promote_candidates, a separate, filed follow-up, not this method's concern since it never promotes).'
claims.why: Requires knowledge of gated_writes.gate_candidates and promote_candidates; not in this chunk.

claims.text: gate_candidates wrapper: 'Landing a candidate this returns into repo_root is a SEPARATE, explicit act -- see promote_candidates and the comment on can_parallel in dispatch for why this method does not do that itself.'
claims.why: References promote_candidates and dispatch comment; not in this chunk.

claims.text: spawn: 'This is the dynamic counterpart to the hardcoded _demo_tasks flow -- the subtasks come from decompose (local model with a deterministic per-path fallback), not a fixed list.'
claims.why: Requires knowledge of decompose function; not in this chunk.

claims.text: configure: 'Dynamic agent configurator: mint or reshape an agent-role definition at runtime. Ikarus owns the crew roster, so creating/editing roles is his job -- routing (router.load_agents) picks up the change with no restart.'
claims.why: References agents_registry and router.load_agents; not in this chunk.

claims.text: configure: 'Returns a summary; raises ValueError on an invalid spec.'
claims.why: No ValueError raise visible in this chunk; may be in agents_registry.

observations.what: gate_candidates method calls self.accept and then gate_candidates from gated_writes.
spawn method imports decompose locally and calls it.
configure method imports agents_registry and uses get_role, update_role, create_role.
_demo_tasks returns a list of dicts with 'objective' and 'paths' from benchmark.TASKS.
main function creates KairosScheduler, calls plan with _demo_tasks, prints output.
